result.instructions: Triangulator monitors Linux processes and their threads. For a past-day question, call list_incidents with the day's start and exclusive end in Unix seconds. It answers the question in one call. Use get_incident for stored evidence. State unknown incident coverage and all omissions. For current status, call status_now: it gives each target's verdict and findings, worst first, as the Triangulator dashboard shows them. Each target has a data object. State its gaps in the answer: a target that is not live, an unreadable view, limited access (no I/O or wait channels), a throttled sampler, packet loss, or an old last sample.

tools.name: timeseries
tools.description: timeseries: historical rollup means for cpu_pct, run_delay_pct, read_bps, write_bps. Threads have opaque lifetime tokens. Coverage and sampler throttling can be unknown; state all gaps. Means weight rollup rows equally. At most 16 KiB, 100 time points or 20 ranked threads. Discovery inspects at most 64 recordings and 64 session/thread pairs.

tools.name: list_targets
tools.description: List the processes that Triangulator monitors, with the key to pass to other tools, the host, PID, command, and data completeness.

tools.name: status_now
tools.description: Is something wrong now? Gives each target's verdict (critical, serious, warning, info, good, or unknown) and its findings, worst first: the same assessment as the dashboard Targets page. Each target has at most 20 findings and a data object that states data completeness.

target.description: A target key or ID from list_targets. Omit it for all targets.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: Was there an issue in a given time window? List overlapping incidents, newest first, with target, kind, severity, summary, ID, and data completeness. At most 20 incidents and 16 KiB; omitted_incidents states the remainder. Open means active at the last scan. An empty result does not prove complete coverage.

target.description: Exact target key, or legacy for unmapped recordings. Omit for all targets.

end.description: Exclusive Unix seconds, greater than start.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Read one stored incident: observation timeline, stored rule evidence, identified contributing threads, and data completeness. The store has no per-sample timeline or contributor ranking. At most 16 KiB; omitted_fields states removed evidence.
